name: MICTIA: Misión al Millón
summary: MICTIA: Misión al Millón is a free-to-play 3D action-adventure game developed by YUKOLOF. Explore Planet Michi, overcome obstacles, collect MichiCoins and help the community reach a shared goal of one million coins. Between runs, visit the Base Mictiana to check community progress, customize your character and view player rankings.
